title: [06.14] Map - Thị trấn Hunderstone hiện tại & bản đồ đề xuất
prompt: The maps below show Hunderstone town at present and a proposed plan for it.
guide:
### 📌 HƯỚNG DẪN TỪNG BƯỚC VIẾT TASK 1 DẠNG MAP (TRẠM IELTS)

---
### PHẦN 1: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT INTRODUCTION (1 câu)

#### Bước 1: Phân tích và Paraphrase
* *The maps show Hunderstone town at present* => *The diagrams compare the current infrastructure of Hunderstone town*
* *and a proposed plan for it* => *with a future development master plan*

#### Bước 2: Công thức và Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
* **Công thức:** `The two maps illustrate + [the existing layout of Hunderstone town] + alongside + [planned future developments].`
* **Câu viết hoàn chỉnh:**
> *The two maps illustrate the existing layout of Hunderstone town alongside planned future developments.*

---
### PHẦN 2: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT OVERVIEW (2 câu)

#### Bước 1: Xác định 2 đặc điểm nổi bật nhất
* **Mục tiêu quy hoạch:** Quy hoạch tập trung mạnh vào phát triển công nghiệp và mở rộng mạng lưới giao thông đường bộ để giảm tải cho trung tâm thị trấn.
* **Hạ tầng nổi bật:** Sân bay (Air field) bị xóa sổ để thay bằng khu công nghiệp (Industrial estate); xây thêm tuyến đường tránh phía Đông bao quanh thị trấn.

#### Bước 2: Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
* **Câu 1 (Mục tiêu tổng quát):** *Overall, the proposed plan aims to modernize the town by expanding industrial capacity and constructing new bypass roads to improve connectivity.*
* **Câu 2 (Thay đổi lớn nhất):** *The most significant alterations involve replacing the airfield with an industrial estate and creating a new ring road on the eastern side of the railway line.*

---
### PHẦN 3: CHIẾN THUẬT CHIA THÂN BÀI (PARAGRAPH DIVISION)

Lấy đường sắt chạy dọc Bắc - Nam (**Railway**) làm ranh giới chia 2 đoạn:
* **Body 1 (Phía Tây đường sắt - The West):** Sân bay đổi thành Khu công nghiệp; vòng xuyến, đường A2 và trạm xăng được giữ lại/nâng cấp.
* **Body 2 (Phía Đông đường sắt - The East):** Trung tâm thị trấn (Town Center) và đường vành đai mới (Bypass/Ring road) chạy bọc vòng phía Đông Bắc.

---
### PHẦN 4: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT CHI TIẾT TỪNG BODY

#### BODY 1: KHU VỰC PHÍA TÂY ĐƯỜNG SẮT (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Sân bay biến thành khu công nghiệp):** *To the west of the railway line, the airfield currently situated in the north-west corner will be completely decommissioned and replaced by a large industrial estate.*
* **Câu 2 (Nút giao thông vòng xuyến):** *The existing roundabout on the A2 road will remain in place to provide vehicular access directly into this newly proposed industrial zone.*
* **Câu 3 (Trạm xăng phía Nam):** *Further south along the A2 highway, the current gas station will be retained in its original position to serve traveling motorists.*

#### BODY 2: KHU VỰC PHÍA ĐÔNG ĐƯỜNG SẮT (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Trung tâm thị trấn mở rộng):** *On the eastern side of the railway track, the Town Center and its existing built-up ring road will undergo further urban expansion.*
* **Câu 2 (Tuyến đường tránh mới):** *Most notably, a new major bypass road is planned to branch off from the northern section of the railway, looping around the eastern perimeter of the town center.*
* **Câu 3 (Kết nối hạ tầng phía Nam):** *This new highway will curve southward and reconnect with the main road network, diverting through-traffic away from the core urban area.*

---
### PHẦN 5: TỔNG HỢP CÔNG THỨC FULL BÀI (CHEATSHEET)

1. **Intro:** `The two maps illustrate the existing layout of Hunderstone town alongside planned future developments.`
2. **Overview:** `Overall, the plan emphasizes industrial growth and road improvements. The airfield will become an industrial zone and an eastern bypass will be constructed.`
3. **Body 1 (West of railway):** `The north-west airfield will be replaced by an industrial estate. The roundabout and southern gas station will remain.`
4. **Body 2 (East of railway):** `The Town Center will expand. A new eastern bypass road will loop around the urban core to alleviate traffic congestion.`

---
### PHẦN 6: BÀI BÁO CÁO MẪU HOÀN CHỈNH (BAND 7.0 - 7.5 REPORT)

The two maps illustrate the existing layout of Hunderstone town alongside planned future developments.

Overall, the proposed plan aims to modernize the town by expanding industrial capacity and constructing new bypass roads to improve connectivity. The most significant alterations involve replacing the airfield with an industrial estate and creating a new ring road on the eastern side of the railway line.

To the west of the railway line, the airfield currently situated in the north-west corner will be completely decommissioned and replaced by a large industrial estate. The existing roundabout on the A2 road will remain in place to provide vehicular access directly into this newly proposed industrial zone. Further south along the A2 highway, the current gas station will be retained in its original position to serve traveling motorists.

On the eastern side of the railway track, the Town Center and its existing built-up ring road will undergo further urban expansion. Most notably, a new major bypass road is planned to branch off from the northern section of the railway, looping around the eastern perimeter of the town center. This new highway will curve southward and reconnect with the main road network, diverting through-traffic away from the core urban area.
